incomeDefinition: Rows include sales to other parts of the group. The group’s revenue from operations removes those internal sales.
definition: The company’s result per activity includes its share of earnings from certain investments. The table shows results before net group financing costs, unusual items and tax.
location: PDF page 32 · Consolidated statement of segment revenue, results, assets and liabilities. Notes on PDF pages 37–38 and 44–45.
notes: After removing ₹189.75 crore of internal sales, group revenue from operations was ₹7,331.86 crore. The ongoing businesses lost ₹182.59 crore before separately reported unusual items and tax. Unusual items added a net ₹963.76 crore, mainly from removing an amount Kamalanga had recorded as owed to a contractor. Group profit after tax was ₹613.69 crore including discontinued operations. The share of profit from an investment also included ₹169.46 crore from undoing an earlier cut to its asset value.
insight: Power contributed the largest reported result. Smart Meter Infrastructure made a positive contribution before shared financing costs, unusual items and tax.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment revenue before removing internal sales
